protocol.question: Which part of the combined original-image versus fixed-image control explains the original-only timing flags: ASLR, or the pathname/inode/padded-image bundle?
protocol.selection: Every originally flagged native or mixed workload from either candidate or A/A; additionally the SSL64 raw beneficiary in every native compiler profile. No old result removed.
protocol.semantics: Frozen consumers, source variants, object checks and real corpora remain unchanged. Record state equality for every sample.
protocol.mixed_costs: Collect the unchanged run(Session&, vector<uint8_t> const&, unsigned) function for three single-pass calls; compare all self counts and original executable PCs outside native timing.
protocol.interpretation: A factorial launch comparison isolates factors, not a hardware microarchitectural mechanism. A/A or other unstable observations are not gain evidence. No publication is authorized by this experiment alone.

policy: All predeclared observations and all data relocations are retained. Layout movement is not itself a timing verdict. No outlier removal; 2000 deterministic resamples of 21 balanced cycles. Simulated instruction counts are not native cycles.
